components.name: Text link
components.description: The standard inline action and destination treatment.
components.css: .ds-text-link { color: var(--accent, #7b8cde); font: 400 1rem/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-text-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { border-radius: 2px; outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7b8cde); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.description: Compact product and support wayfinding inside the shared measure.
components.html: LaikasoftStonemiteSupport
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; width: min(100%, 640px); padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; background: #0a0a12; } .ds-nav a { text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-logo { margin-right: auto; color: #c8c8d4; font: 600 0.9rem/1.6 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', monospace; } .ds-nav-link { color: #85859a; font: 400 0.85rem/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { color: #7b8cde; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { border-radius: 2px; outline: 2px solid #7b8cde; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-support-route { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; padding: 1.5rem 0; border-top: 1px solid #1e1e30; border-bottom: 1px solid #1e1e30; background: #0a0a12; color: #c8c8d4; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-support-route h2 { margin: 0 0 0.35rem; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-support-route p { margin: 0; color: #85859a; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-support-route a { color: #7b8cde; font: 500 0.85rem/1.6 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', monospace; text-decoration: none; } .ds-support-route a:hover span { display: inline-block; transform: translateX(0.2rem); transition: transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-support-route a:focus-visible { border-radius: 2px; outline: 2px solid #7b8cde; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 540px) { .ds-support-route { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0.85rem; padding: 1.35rem 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-support-route a:hover span { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: Laikasoft is a compact technical directory rather than a marketing stage. One narrow column, spare copy, and high-confidence text links make each page feel direct and maintained. The dark field supports late-night game and desktop use without adding fantasy decoration or dashboard chrome. The system earns hierarchy through type register, spacing, and one-pixel divisions. Product art appears only when it carries identity; support and navigation remain typographic.
keyCharacteristics: A near-black, single-column canvas with no ornamental panels.
Cool grey text and one muted indigo action color.
Monospace for product identity and actions; system sans for explanation.
Short pages, plain language, and visible authoritative links.

rules.name: The Action Color Rule
rules.body: Link indigo means an element can be followed or focused. Do not scatter it onto decorative labels.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Monospace names the place or the action; system sans explains it.

rules.name: The One-Column Rule
rules.body: Add hierarchy inside the shared measure before considering a second region or sidebar.

dos: Do keep pages concise enough that the next useful action is visible quickly.
Do use semantic headings, descriptive links, aria-current, and visible keyboard focus.
Do use product artwork only for real product identity.
Do divide parallel choices with hairlines rather than wrapping each one in a card.
donts: Don't add fantasy-game ornament, neon glow, glass, or decorative gradients.
Don't turn short support content into a dashboard, card grid, or simulated help centre.
Don't use muted text below accessible contrast on the night canvas.
Don't promise support channels, response times, or product claims that are not documented in PRODUCT.md.
